description: This file implements command-line flag parsing utilities for the etcd project, including environment variable integration and flag management.

methods.name: SetFlagsFromEnv
methods.description: Parses registered flags and sets their values from environment variables if not already set.

methods.name: SetPflagsFromEnv
methods.description: Similar to SetFlagsFromEnv but for pflag.FlagSet, without logging.

methods.name: FlagToEnv
methods.description: Converts a flag name to an uppercase environment variable name with prefix.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if a specific flag is explicitly set in the flag set.

methods.name: GetBoolFlagVal
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of a flag if explicitly set, otherwise nil.
